property_summary: For any actor and any two deposit amounts, getBalance(actor) after a second addToBalance equals the balance before it plus the second amount (balances accumulate); the mutant overwrites the prior balance with only the latest msg.value, so the rule breaks whenever the first deposit was nonzero.
change_summary: Replace the balance update `userBalance[msg.sender] += msg.value;` with an assignment `userBalance[msg.sender] = msg.value;`, discarding prior balance.
